references.text: The parallel instruction given by God to Moses regarding the design of the lampstand, where knobs were to be placed under each pair of branches extending from the main stem.
The complete description of God's instructions for the lampstand (menorah), which Bezalel carried out in chapter 37.
The full account of Bezalel's work on the lampstand, where verse 21 describes the placement of the knobs under the branches.
The description of the lampstand's design, made according to the pattern shown by the Lord to Moses.
Hebrews mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle and confirms its significance in worship.
